A car of mass 1000kg travelling at 8.0m/s collides with a lorry of mass 3000kg that is travelling
at 2.0m/s in the same direction. After colliding, the two vehicles stick together.
What is their speed after the collision?
A
2.0m/s
B
2.5m/s
C
3.5m/s
D
5.0m/s
subject: Physics
